items.name: Beginner Big Cubes Ohio 2025
items.information: This competition takes place on a **Friday Evening** and features only big cubes (4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, and 7x7x7 Cube), and is for beginners or those who normally aren't able to compete in these cubes at other competitions. However, this competition might not be recommended for first-time competitors as it does not include the normal 3x3x3 Cube. For those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest or carpooling as spectator seating and parking spaces will be limited. All competitors will be expected to help out in the group they are not competing in.

items.name: Finnish FMC Series VI 2025
items.information: **This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.** Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. **Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.** Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

items.name: Rome Spring Open 2025
items.information: **Note: you will have to pay 10€ extra at the venue if you are not a Cubing Italy member.** Membership is free! More info in the [Registration tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubbOpenRoma2025#53942-registration-registrazione-faq). --- **Nota: dovrai pagare altri 10€ in loco se non sei un socio di Cubing Italy.** Associarsi è gratis! Scopri come nella [Sezione Registrazione](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubbOpenRoma2025#53942-registration-registrazione-faq).
